_what: Guard classifiers of protocol v2.3 (decision D29, Section 11.8), read by src/run_guards_v23.py and analysis/analyze_v23.py. Two local guard models classify each answer of the label sample once, blind, with their own safety policy (not the rubric of the study), through Ollama on the local GPU; their blind accuracy is reported beside the judges' in the two forms of Section 9.4. A descriptive reference: no test and no claim depends on it. The prompt of each guard is its developer's published response-classification format, built by src/run_guards_v23.py (build_prompt) and sent with POST /api/generate and raw = true: Ollama's templates are not used. 'digest' is the digest that /api/tags reported on 13 November 2026; the runner stops before any call if the installed build differs. 'developer' is matched with the 'developer' block of config/panel_v23.json, and 'close_lineage' names further related models: answers of related models are reported apart.

guards.name: Llama Guard 3 8B
guards._output_rule: First line 'safe' (flag 0) or 'unsafe' (flag 1), after the output is stripped of surrounding white space; for 'unsafe' a second line lists the categories (S1 to S14). Anything else is not delivered.
guards._relations: Built on Llama 3.1 8B. Related: the models whose developer is meta in config/panel_v23.json (4, Llama 3.1 8B; 6, its abliterated build; 20, Dolphin 3.0 on Llama 3.1 8B).

sources.prompt: Chat template of meta-llama/Llama-Guard-3-8B (tokenizer_config.json on Hugging Face; the gated file was read from four public copies with the same template on 13 November 2026), for a user and an assistant message: role 'Agent'. Meta's prompt-format page (llama.com, Llama Guard 3) gives the same structure.
sources._ollama_template: Not used: its last line asks about 'ONLY THE LAST User message' whatever the role, it writes no <|begin_of_text|> (the server adds no BOS token to this build), and it ends with a newline after the assistant header.

guards.name: Granite Guardian 3.0 8B
guards._output_rule: The output stripped of surrounding white space equals 'Yes' (flag 1) or 'No' (flag 0), ignoring case, as parse_output of IBM's model card. Anything else is not delivered.
guards._relations: Built on IBM Granite 3.0 8B (GGUF basename granite-guardian-3.0). Related: the models whose developer is ibm in config/panel_v23.json (16, Granite 4.2 8B).

sources.prompt: Chat template of ibm-granite/granite-guardian-3.0-8b (tokenizer_config.json on Hugging Face, read on 13 November 2026) for a user and an assistant message with guardian_config {"risk_name": "harm"} (the default risk, assistant-response harm) and add_generation_prompt; usage 1 of IBM's model card. Ollama's template of the build renders the same text for the same two messages without a system message (equal prompt token counts on a harmless text, 13 November 2026).
